title: US Recruiter
description:
Role Summary 
As a Recruiter in our India Global Capability Centre (GCC), you will manage end-to-end recruitment for one or more US partner facilities. Working closely with onsite site leaders and hiring managers, you will develop and execute recruitment plans, source and screen candidates through digital channels, conduct virtual interviews, and guide candidates smoothly through each stage of the hiring process.
Although you will not be onsite, you will develop a strong understanding of the operation to ensure facilities remain fully staffed. You will serve as a key link between candidates, hiring managers, and onsite teams.
 Essential Job Functions 
 Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with US hiring managers and site leaders via Microsoft Teams, phone, and email to understand staffing needs, shift patterns, and job requirements. Recruitment Planning: Develop and execute recruitment plans for assigned facilities, including weekly hiring targets and pipeline forecasts. Candidate Sourcing and Screening: Source and screen candidates through job boards, social media, ATS databases, referral programs, and text or email campaigns. Candidate Interviews: Conduct phone interviews to assess candidates' suitability, availability, and qualifications. Hiring and Onboarding Coordination: Manage the hiring process from offer through onboarding, including background checks, drug screening, and pre-employment documentation. Coordinate with onsite teams for in-person requirements such as I-9 verification and orientation. Talent Pipeline Management: Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified candidates to meet recurring and peak-season hiring demands. Recruitment Operations and Compliance: Manage paperless recruiting operations and ensure ATS/HRIS data remains accurate, up to date, and audit-ready. 
 Experience and Qualifications 
 Education: Graduate degree in any discipline. An MBA or specialization in Human Resources is an added advantage. Recruitment Experience: Minimum of 2 years of recruiting experience, preferably in US high-volume or hourly hiring across light industrial, warehouse, manufacturing, or logistics environments. US Hiring Practices: Familiarity with US recruitment practices, including background checks, drug screening, I-9/E-Verify processes, and basic Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) guidelines. Systems Knowledge: Hands-on experience with an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and/or Human Resources Information System (HRIS). Technical Skills: Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word. Communication Skills: Clear and confident spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate effectively with US candidates and stakeholders. Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal, relationship-building, and customer service skills. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Good problem-solving and analytical abilities, including the capacity to interpret data and work with dashboards. Work Management: Ability to work independently in a hybrid setup, prioritize tasks effectively, and manage responsibilities across different time zones.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
POSITION SUMMARY: The Head of Talent Acquisition is responsible for designing and executing the organization's talent acquisition strategy to attract, engage, and hire high-quality talent across manufacturing plants, corporate functions, commercial teams, and leadership positions. The role will drive workforce planning, employer branding, recruitment excellence, talent pipeline development, and digital hiring transformation while ensuring quality, speed, diversity, and cost-effective hiring outcomes aligned with business growth objectives. 
 Talent Acquisition Strategy Develop and implement a comprehensive talent acquisition strategy aligned with business growth plans. Partner with business leaders and HRBPs to forecast talent needs and create hiring plans. Build proactive talent pipelines for critical and niche positions. Lead workforce planning initiatives across manufacturing plants and corporate offices. 
 Recruitment & Selection Manage end-to-end recruitment for leadership, technical, engineering, manufacturing, commercial, and support function roles. Ensure timely fulfillment of open positions while maintaining hiring quality standards. Establish robust candidate evaluation frameworks and competency-based hiring practices. 
 Leadership & Critical Talent Hiring Lead executive and senior leadership hiring initiatives. Develop succession-oriented talent pipelines for key business-critical roles. Partner with external executive search firms when required. 
 Employer Branding & Candidate Experience Strengthen the organizations employer value proposition (EVP). Enhance candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle. Manage talent branding initiatives across professional networks, universities, and industry platforms. Represent the company in recruitment events, career fairs, and employer branding forums. 
 Campus & Early Career Programs Develop strategic partnerships with engineering, management, and technical institutions. Lead campus hiring programs, graduate trainee programs, apprenticeships, and internship initiatives. Build future talent pipelines to meet long-term workforce requirements. 
 Recruitment Technology & Analytics Leverage ATS, , and recruitment analytics to improve hiring effectiveness. Monitor hiring metrics and create dashboards for leadership review. Drive digitization and automation initiatives within recruitment processes. 
 Vendor & Stakeholder Management Manage recruitment agencies, search partners, and talent sourcing vendors. Negotiate contracts and optimize recruitment costs. Build strong relationships with business leaders, HR teams, and external stakeholders. 
 Diversity & Inclusion Develop and implement diversity hiring strategies. Ensure fair, equitable, and unbiased recruitment practices. Support organizational DEI goals through targeted sourcing initiatives. 
 Governance & Compliance Ensure compliance with labor laws, company policies, and recruitment governance standards. Maintain hiring process integrity, audit readiness, and data privacy compliance 
 SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: The incumbent reports to TA Head APAC and dotted line to Head HR - India and support her in all day to day activities to achieve the business objectives of the company. TA team report into this position. 
 QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Bechelors degree in HR / MSW / MBA (HR) from a reputed institution. Over 8 years of HR experience with at least 8 years in Talent Acquisition. Strong business acumen, stakeholder management, and leadership presence. Proven experience in managing complex ER/IR environments and statutory compliance. Experience working in matrix/global environments preferred. 
 REQUIRED SKILLS: Strategic Thinking Business Acumen Stakeholder Management Influencing & Negotiation Change Management Team Leadership 
 PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Regular travel to Gates manufacturing plants\office locations\Colleges across India.

title: Us It Recruiter
description:
Role & responsibilities We are looking for a US IT Recruiter to manage the recruitment lifecycle for technology roles across the US market. The role involves understanding hiring requirements, sourcing and screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and supporting offer negotiations and onboarding. 
 Key Responsibilities Work with hiring managers, account managers, and delivery teams to understand technical requirements and hiring priorities. Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, internal databases, referrals, and professional networks. Screen candidates for technical skills, relevant experience, communication, availability, compensation expectations, and work authorization. Recruit for contract, contract-to-hire, and permanent positions, including W2 and C2C engagements as applicable. Submit relevant profiles with clear screening summaries within agreed timelines. Coordinate interviews, collect feedback, and maintain regular communication with candidates and stakeholders. Support rate and salary negotiations, offer acceptance, joining follow-ups, and onboarding coordination. Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activity in the applicant tracking system. Build candidate pipelines for recurring and hard-to-fill technology requirements. Track submissions, interviews, offers, and placements against recruitment targets. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Experience in US IT recruitment with an understanding of the full recruitment lifecycle. Familiarity with technology roles across software development, AI , Data Engineering, QA, cloud, DevOps, and infrastructure. Strong sourcing skills, including Boolean searches and candidate database searches. Understanding of US employment arrangements, work authorization categories, and recruitment terminology. Excellent written and verbal communication, candidate engagement, and negotiation skills. Ability to manage multiple requirements and work effectively with US-based stakeholders. Experience using an ATS and maintaining recruitment reports. Willingness to work US business hours. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting US staffing clients or direct-client requirements. Familiarity with vendor management systems and managed service provider recruitment processes. A track record of meeting placement targets and maintaining strong candidate relationships. Bachelors degree or equivalent relevant experience.

Key Skills: US Staffing,US IT Recruitment,US Recruitment,IT recruitment,Staffing,Recruitment

title: Hr Executive And Recruiter
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 HR Executive Talent Acquisition & HR Operations 
 Department: Human Resources
 Designation: HR Executive
 Location: Vasant Vihar 
 Reporting To: HR Manager 
 Experience: 13 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 1. Job Summary 
We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented HR Executive to manage end-to-end recruitment, talent acquisition, employee onboarding, pre-boarding, HR documentation, and exit formalities.
The candidate will be responsible for sourcing and screening suitable candidates, coordinating interviews, maintaining recruitment records in KEKA , ensuring smooth joining formalities, and supporting day-to-day HR operations.
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Talent Acquisition & Recruitment 
 Manage the end-to-end recruitment process from candidate sourcing to joining.
 Understand manpower requirements and coordinate with HR manager for open positions.
 Search and source candidates through Naukri/Resdex, job portals, LinkedIn, employee references, databases, and other recruitment channels .
 Screen resumes based on job requirements, experience, qualifications, location, and role suitability.
 Conduct initial HR screening calls with shortlisted candidates.
 Explain the job profile, responsibilities, location, working hours, salary structure, and other relevant requirements to candidates.
 Maintain an active candidate pipeline for current and upcoming vacancies.
 Follow up with candidates regularly throughout the recruitment process.
 Ensure timely closure of assigned vacancies.
 B. Interview Coordination 
 Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and HR Manager and CEO.
 Align interview slots based on candidate and interviewer availability.
 Share interview details and candidate profiles with HR Manager.
 Maintain proper records of scheduled, completed, shortlisted, rejected, and pending interviews.
 Take regular feedback from interviewers and update candidates accordingly.
 Ensure minimum delays between different stages of the recruitment process.
 Follow up with candidates who miss or postpone interviews and reschedule wherever required.
 C. Candidate Calling & Follow-Ups 
 Make regular recruitment calls to prospective candidates.
 Follow up with shortlisted candidates regarding interview schedules, documentation, salary discussions, and joining dates.
 Maintain professional communication with candidates throughout the hiring process.
 Track candidates who are under offer, serving notice period, or awaiting joining.
 Reduce candidate drop-offs through timely communication and engagement.
 D. Pre-Boarding 
 Coordinate with selected candidates before their date of joining.
 Collect and verify required pre-joining documents.
 Share joining instructions, reporting details, location, timings, and other relevant information.
 Maintain regular communication with candidates during the notice period.
 Confirm joining status one day prior to the joining date.
 Coordinate with the concerned department/clinic to ensure readiness for the new employee.
 E. Onboarding & Joining Formalities 
 Coordinate complete employee onboarding and joining formalities.
 Ensure all required documents and employee information are collected.
 Create/update employee records in KEKA .
 Ensure timely completion of joining documentation and HR formalities.
 Coordinate with relevant departments for ID cards, system access, email IDs, uniforms, assets, and other requirements wherever applicable.
 Ensure new employees are properly introduced to the organization and reporting structure.
 Coordinate with reporting managers regarding the employee's joining and induction.
 F. KEKA HRMS Management 
 Maintain accurate employee and recruitment-related information in KEKA SOFTWARE .
 Update candidate/employee status at every relevant stage.
 Complete joining and onboarding activities in KEKA.
 Initiate and track required HR processes and notifications through KEKA.
 Maintain employee records, documentation, attendance-related information, and separation records as assigned.
 Ensure timely and accurate HRMS data updates.
 G. Exit & Separation Formalities 
 Coordinate employee resignation and separation processes.
 Ensure employees complete required exit formalities and documentation.
 Coordinate with reporting managers and concerned departments for clearance and handover.
 Initiate and update separation formalities in KEKA.
 Coordinate asset handover, department clearance, and other exit requirements.
 Maintain proper records of resigned, relieved, and separated employees.
 Coordinate with HR/Finance/concerned departments regarding Full & Final (F&F) formalities as per company policy.
 Conduct or coordinate exit interviews and maintain relevant records.
 
 4. Required Skills & Competencies 
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
 Good candidate sourcing and screening skills.
 Strong calling and follow-up abilities.
 Good knowledge of recruitment processes.
 Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.
 Strong coordination and time-management skills.
 Good working knowledge of KEKA or other HRMS platforms .
 Working knowledge of Naukri/Resdex, LinkedIn, and other recruitment platforms.
 Good MS Excel/Google Sheets skills.
 Strong documentation and record-keeping skills.
 Ability to work under deadlines and achieve recruitment targets.
 Proactive approach with strong ownership and follow-through.
 Professional and positive attitude.

 5. Qualification & Experience 
 Education: Graduate in HR, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
 Experience: 03 years of experience in HR recruitment/talent acquisition or HR operations.
Candidates with experience in healthcare, aesthetics, wellness, clinics, hospitality, retail, sales, or other high-volume recruitment environments will be preferred
